The weighted hospital bedflow calculator passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the core logic for risk-adjusted capacity modeling is sound.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.73 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 successfully validated the logic in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While successful, LiteLLM warnings regarding missing 'botocore' modules suggest potential environment dependencies to monitor if scaling to AWS-based runtimes.
